Recorded claim:
Bug 1895920 ported upstream Bug 1892103. The accepted commit removed the tb-esmify mach registration, its 707-line mach command, and its 417-line conversion map. Upstream Bugzilla states that in-tree code was fully converted to ECMAScript modules, so the in-tree migration tool no longer served its purpose and obscured code searches. Do not refer to tb-esmify as a current Thunderbird mach command; retrieve it from history only for an exceptional out-of-tree migration. The current checkout has no tb-esmify reference in build, tools or mail.

Provenance: 133de361bb91f2005c1f66ae51af892a4ac43e57ed4f71d2e16f02d0d64d5935. Original evidence IDs: 42a807fc65e317b5c1c1d075022e3fd212d8bd5c2ac30b3c54e121213718f478, 8838875868c92390db19bb7c02bb62e3120c690ac032701978c0011434443f12, fa47e1ccd0b11fc2f430e7c3d0f3ec9e760ad4477d69718fd4bfec861855bc2d.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
